summary: Aegon Ltd. (issuer) announced final results of tender offers for five series of subordinated perpetual notes: EUR 950M 2004 Perpetual Capital Securities, USD 500M 2004 Perpetual Capital Securities, and three NLG-denominated perpetual cumulative subordinated bonds (1995, October 1996, February 1996). Purchase prices per series: 80.25% (2004 EUR), 78.75% (2004 USD), 89.625% (1995 NLG), 81.50% (Oct 1996), and 89.625% (Feb 1996). Total accepted notional: EUR 379.6M. Aegon accepted all valid tenders without pro-rata scaling. Settlement expected on May 12, 2026. This is a liability management exercise reducing outstanding subordinated debt. What to watch: impact on credit metrics and potential future refinancing.
